scenarios.description: A listed corporate action on the relevant non-conclusive list occurs between two regular rebalance days. Solactive accounts for it in the index calculation, applies the adjustment from the cum-day to the ex-day, and the adjustment coincides with the price effect.
Solactive treats a corporate action as relevant for index maintenance but makes no adjustment to the index and does not implement it from the cum-day to the ex-day.

A corporate action is not on the listed set, but Solactive still considers it for index maintenance and applies an adjustment. The source text does not say whether the list is exhaustive, only that it is not conclusive.

Solactive deviates from standard procedures for a corporate action that is neither unusual nor complex and does not preserve comparability or representativeness over time, while still claiming the deviation is in accordance with the methodology.
